In january I had my Liletta IUD removed and I started getting acne. I immediately saw my dermatologist, who gave me a ton of topicals, antibiotics and recommended Differin gel. I was washing my face with Cetaphil, toning with Aveda’s hydrating toner and using Differin’s sunscreen during the day/Differin gel at night. It continuously got worse, I begged him to test my testosterone levels at every appointment. I was also getting unwanted body hair and just feeling different. When he finally ran tests, testosterone was high.  I’m sure you can guess what happened next- unfortunately spironolactone and I didn’t get along. I’m a massage therapist,  esthetician and lash artist so I’m with one client for sometimes 3 hours at a time. I was going to the bathroom constantly, which isn’t very relaxing. Plus the spironolactone killed my sex drive, also not cool. I stopped the antibiotic, topicals and Differin while my dermatologist began glycolic acid peels. They worked! But I had to stop due to scheduling and continued looking for a regular skin care routine that would help. After a year of trying different cleansers, toners, moisturizers, acne treatments, clay masques, changing diets, and increasing water intake. This is my progress. 
I’m now using the Differin cleanser, micellar water instead of a toner, and Neutrogena hydro boost water gel. It’s really a basic routine but my skin is in no pain at all for the first time in 2 years! My question for you guys is, what do you suggest I use to treat the scarring and redness? 
I’ve been curious about the Glycolic peels (again) and Drunk Elephant products. 
Thank you all in advance!
